title: Custom Operations and Extensions knowledge check

options: This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.

Measure a representative baseline with warm-up and repeated trials, change one factor, and re-check output quality before claiming improvement.
This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
questions.answer_key: Measure a representative baseline with warm-up and repeated trials, change one factor, and re-check output quality before claiming improvement.
questions.explanation: When built-in operators are insufficient: Measure a representative baseline with warm-up and repeated trials, change one factor, and re-check output quality before claiming improvement.

confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Custom operator concepts”?
options: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
